about: Where the formal proof's assumptions enter and where they are discharged: the structures behind the blueprint arrows borne out only as hypotheses, and for every statement's Prop the theorems that conclude it. Written by tools/lean-edges/hypotheses.py from Sutherland's export of the proof; the README beside it says how to rebuild it. No Lean was built.

proof.note: The export holds the dependency closure of the five main theorems, so a declaration missing from it is not used by the proof.

classes.outright: a theorem concludes the Prop with no premise typed by a blueprint Prop or a structure below
classes.conditional: every theorem that concludes the Prop has such a premise
classes.never: no theorem in the proof concludes the Prop
classes.absent: the Prop is not in the formal proof
